Comparison of Network Topologies
Network Topologies
A network topology defines the physical or logical arrangement of nodes and commu￾nication links in a network. Different topologies offer different trade-offs in terms of
performance, cost, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Comparative Analysis of Network Topologies
Topology Use Cases
Important Technical Points
• Star topology is the most commonly used topology in modern LANs.
• Mesh topology offers highest reliability but is expensive.
• Bus and ring topologies are rarely used in modern networks.
• Tree topology is an extension of star topology.
• Hybrid topology is most practical for large-scale networks.
